intro: A plate of nasi beriani kambing has about 900 kcal. Much of the calories come from rice cooked with ghee and the fatty mutton gravy.
diet: Yes, but this is a festive or once-in-a-while dish. Ghee and mutton fat make it high in calories. At a kenduri, take a little rice and focus on the lauk. Eat lighter on other days to balance it out.
tips: Pick leaner mutton pieces and remove the visible fat.
Take half a plate of rice, and add cucumber and pineapple acar.
Skip the papadom if you're already full.

swap.name: Chicken beriani, half rice + acar
swap.why: Chicken has less fat than mutton and the rice portion is controlled, but you still get the beriani taste.

faq.a: In Malaysia, 'kambing' on the menu can be goat or sheep (mutton). The taste and texture are slightly different.
Because of spices like cinnamon, star anise, cardamom and cloves, plus ghee.
Usually cucumber, onion and pineapple in vinegar or yogurt. It's fresh and helps balance the rich taste.
